$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (connectors-webshop-orders). The dormant Lightspeed eCom shop template. Its mapping and synchronization are not shipped yet: see the template's description.

objects.name: Lightspeed eCom shop
objects.description: A Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) shop (https://developers.lightspeedhq.com/ecom/). Orders: GET <cluster>/<language>/orders.json, changed-since filter `updated_at_min`. Auth: an API key and secret over HTTP Basic, the secret held by the credential broker. Set the location to your cluster and shop language (for example https://api.webshopapp.com/nl), the API key and the credential. The order list names an order's lines only as a link to a separate resource, so the mapping onto shillinq's WebshopOrder is not shipped with this template yet.
